name: Iris
beschreibung: Ferienhotel Iris is delightfully situated in the sunny high valley of Wildschönau, framed by green alpine pastures and the rolling peaks of the Kitzbühel Alps. The property is celebrated for its warm, attentive hosting and cozy rooms fitted with classic Tyrolean wood furnishings and scenic balconies. Guests start their day with a bountiful breakfast buffet loaded with regional produce. The peaceful garden terrace provides the ideal setting to unwind after mountain explorations. In winter, a dedicated ski bus connects guests to the slopes of Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau, while summer hiking and biking trails depart from the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Welcoming holiday hotel in Wildschönau featuring cozy alpine rooms, a sun terrace, and mountain views.
